text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
With her debut race approaching, she can't 
sit still! Heading to the dojo to channel 
all that pent-up energy, she runs into her 
classmate, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno's got this super cool "dream" to 
fight the strong to hone her mind and 
body, and repay her grandparents by 
showing them how much she's grown!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We promised each other that whenever we 
race, we'd be each other's "strongest foe" 
and "greatest rival"!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!! I'm totally fired up now~~!! I'm 
gonna pump myself up even more! Time to 
blaze on through at full throttle~~!!!!
